'''Vagaari Infiltrators''' or '''Vagaari infiltrators''' were [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] with [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] knowledge and social skills tasked with infiltrating and [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] [[Planet/Legends|planets]] the [[Vagaari Empire]] wished to attack. Disguised as [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] and explorers, the infiltrators made contact with the inhabitants of the planets they were sent to, traded, and obtained data on the planets' custom and defenses. After they departed along their supposed trade routes, the [[Vagaari slaver fleet]] attacked the worlds, using the infiltrators' data to their advantage.<ref name="TUR" />

If a Vagaari infiltrator was discovered and forced into combat, they used deceptive maneuvers to attack their opponents and flee to a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The Vagaari agents sometimes combined their feints with [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]] and [[Blaster/Legends|blaster pilots]], and employed [[Comlink/Legends|comlinks]], [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], and a space's [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. The infiltrators spoke [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], the [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]] [[Language/Legends|trade language]], and [[Vagaari (language)|Vagaari]].<ref name="TUR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vagaari infiltrators were introduced in the [[2010]] sourcebook ''[[The Unknown Regions]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]] for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TUR" />
